description: Express.js route definitions for project-related API endpoints, including listing, creating, retrieving, updating projects, and managing project members.

methods.name: list
methods.description: Handles listing projects accessible to the current user.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Handles creating a new project with provided name and optional description.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Retrieves details of a specific project by projectId.

methods.name: update
methods.description: Updates an existing project identified by projectId.

methods.name: addMember
methods.description: Adds or updates a member in a project by email and role.
